mcu_0160_0800dbec.name: systick_clock_source_config
mcu_0160_0800dbec.summary: Select the SysTick clock source: AHB clock undivided or AHB clock divided by 8
mcu_0160_0800dbec.description: Sets SysTick.CTRL bit 2 (CLKSOURCE) when param_1 equals 4 (SYSTICK_CLOCK_SOURCE_AHBCLK_NODIV) and clears it for any other value, which selects the AHB clock divided by 8 (SYSTICK_CLOCK_SOURCE_AHBCLK_DIV8 = 0). The update is a read-modify-write, so the ENABLE and TICKINT bits are kept. This is the Artery SDK routine systick_clock_source_config. It is called from mcu_0160_0800c8f8 with 4 just before the SysTick counter is started.

params.name: param_1
params.description: clock source: 4 = AHB clock without divider, 0 = AHB clock divided by 8

mcu_0160_0800dd98.name: tmr_32_bit_function_enable
mcu_0160_0800dd98.summary: Set or clear CTRL1.PMEN (Plus Mode Enable, bit 10) on TMR2 and TMR5 only
mcu_0160_0800dd98.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_32_bit_function_enable. Only TMR2 and TMR5, the two 32-bit timers, are affected: for them bit 10 of CTRL1 is replaced with param_2 & 1 by a read-modify-write that keeps the other control bits. For any other timer pointer the function does nothing. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_1
params.description: TMR base pointer (TMR2 or TMR5 are the only ones acted on)

mcu_0160_0800dd98.notes: The repo register data only names CTRL1 bit 10 'Plus Mode Enable'; the hardware effect of PMEN is not documented in the repo. Only caller: mcu_0160_08009800.

mcu_0160_0800ddb2.name: tmr_base_init
mcu_0160_0800ddb2.summary: Load the timer period (PR) and prescaler (DIV) and force an update event
mcu_0160_0800ddb2.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_base_init. param_2 is written to the period register PR (offset 0x2C) and param_3 to the prescaler register DIV (offset 0x28). It then sets SWEVT.OVFSWTR (bit 0 of offset 0x14), which generates an update event so the new values are loaded into the shadow registers at once. The counter is started separately with tmr_counter_enable. The TMR4 setup at mcu_0160_08003060 passes PR = 999 and DIV = 0x8F (143). Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800ddc0.name: tmr_brkdt_config
mcu_0160_0800ddc0.summary: Write the TMR break and dead-time register (BRK) from a 7-byte configuration record
mcu_0160_0800ddc0.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_brkdt_config. Each field is written with its own read-modify-write of BRK (offset 0x44). The 7-byte tmr_brkdt_config_type record at param_2 is laid out as: byte 0 = dead-time value DTC (BRK bits 7:0, full byte), byte 1 = BRKV brake input polarity (bit 13), byte 2 = WPC write-protect level (bits 9:8, 2 bits), byte 3 = AOEN automatic output enable (bit 14), byte 4 = FCSOEN (bit 11), byte 5 = FCSODIS (bit 10), byte 6 = BRKEN brake enable (bit 12). The main output enable OEN (bit 15) is not changed here; it belongs to tmr_output_enable. Part of the TMR helper group.

params.name: param_2
params.description: tmr_brkdt_config_type record (7 bytes, layout in description)

mcu_0160_0800de08.name: tmr_brkdt_default_para_init
mcu_0160_0800de08.summary: Zero the seven fields of a tmr_brkdt_config_type record (default dead-time and brake setup)
mcu_0160_0800de08.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_brkdt_default_para_init. It clears the 7-byte record at param_1, which gives dead-time 0, brake polarity active-low (enum value 0), write protection off, and automatic output, frozen-state and brake enables all FALSE. The caller fills in the fields it needs and passes the record to tmr_brkdt_config (mcu_0160_0800ddc0).
mcu_0160_0800de08.notes: The seven-byte zeroing body is identical to mcu_0160_0800e102 (tmr_output_default_para_init), so the two records cannot be told apart from the code alone. Only caller: mcu_0160_0800a6b8.

mcu_0160_0800de1a.name: tmr_channel1_input_select
mcu_0160_0800de1a.summary: Set CTRL2.C1INSEL (bit 7), the source selection for the channel 1 input
mcu_0160_0800de1a.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_channel1_input_select. Read-modify-write of bit 7 of CTRL2 (offset 0x04) with param_2 & 1. The register data calls the bit 'C1IN selection'; what each value connects is not given in the repo register data. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800de24.name: tmr_channel_enable
mcu_0160_0800de24.summary: Enable or disable one output channel or its complementary output in CCTRL
mcu_0160_0800de24.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_channel_enable. param_2 is a TMR_SELECT_CHANNEL code: 0 = C1EN (CCTRL bit 0), 1 = C1CEN (bit 2), 2 = C2EN (bit 4), 3 = C2CEN (bit 6), 4 = C3EN (bit 8), 5 = C3CEN (bit 10), 6 = C4EN (bit 12); any other value does nothing. The selected bit is replaced with param_3 & 1 by a read-modify-write of CCTRL (offset 0x20). Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: channel code 0..6 (0 = CH1, 1 = CH1 complementary, ... 6 = CH4)

mcu_0160_0800de7a.name: tmr_channel_value_set
mcu_0160_0800de7a.summary: Write the compare value of channel 1 to 4 (C1DT..C4DT) selected by channel code
mcu_0160_0800de7a.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_channel_value_set. param_2 selects the data register: 0 = C1DT (offset 0x34), 2 = C2DT (0x38), 4 = C3DT (0x3C), 6 = C4DT (0x40). Complementary codes 1, 3 and 5 are not handled, and any other value does nothing. The value is stored as a plain 32-bit write; on advanced timers the field is 16 bits wide, so only the low 16 bits take effect. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: channel code: 0 = channel 1, 2 = channel 2, 4 = channel 3, 6 = channel 4

mcu_0160_0800de9a.name: tmr_clock_source_div_set
mcu_0160_0800de9a.summary: Set CTRL1.CLKDIV (bits 9:8), the clock divider of the timer
mcu_0160_0800de9a.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_clock_source_div_set. Read-modify-write of the 2-bit field at bits 9:8 of the first word of the block (CTRL1 for a TMR) with param_2 & 3, keeping the other bits. In the usual timer design this divider sets the clock used by dead-time generation and the input filters; the repo register data only says 'Clock divider', so that use is not confirmed here. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_1
params.description: TMR base pointer (first word is CTRL1)

mcu_0160_0800dea4.name: tmr_cnt_dir_set
mcu_0160_0800dea4.summary: Set CTRL1.CNT_DIR (bits 6:4): counting direction and center-aligned mode
mcu_0160_0800dea4.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_cnt_dir_set. Read-modify-write of the 3-bit CNT_DIR field at bits 6:4 of CTRL1 (OWCDIR at bit 4, TWCMSEL at bits 6:5 in the register data) with param_2 & 7; other CTRL1 bits are kept. The value selects up, down or one of the center-aligned counting modes (tmr_count_mode_type). Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800deae.name: tmr_counter_enable
mcu_0160_0800deae.summary: Start or stop the timer counter through CTRL1.TMREN (bit 0)
mcu_0160_0800deae.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_counter_enable. Read-modify-write of bit 0 (TMREN) of CTRL1 with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. This is the switch that starts or stops the counter after the base and channel setup. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: confirm_state: non-zero starts the counter, zero stops it

mcu_0160_0800deb8.name: tmr_flag_clear
mcu_0160_0800deb8.summary: Clear interrupt status flags by writing the inverted mask to ISTS
mcu_0160_0800deb8.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_flag_clear. Stores ~param_2 into the interrupt status register ISTS (offset 0x10) with a plain store, not a read-modify-write. ISTS flags are cleared by writing 0, so only the bits set in the mask are cleared; the other bits are written as 1 and have no effect. The TMR4 global interrupt handler mcu_0160_0800a85c is one of the callers. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: mask of status flags to clear

mcu_0160_0800debe.name: tmr_flag_get
mcu_0160_0800debe.summary: Return true if any of the masked TMR interrupt status flags is set
mcu_0160_0800debe.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_flag_get. Reads ISTS (offset 0x10) and returns whether (ISTS & param_2) is non-zero, so it is true when any masked flag is set. It does not clear anything; clearing is done with tmr_flag_clear. It is called from the TMR4 global interrupt handler mcu_0160_0800a85c, which polls the timer status flags. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: mask of status flags to test

returns.description: true if any masked flag bit is set

mcu_0160_0800decc.name: mcu_tmr_output_channel_setup
mcu_0160_0800decc.summary: Configure one TMR output channel (polarity, output mode, enable) from a 4-byte record
mcu_0160_0800decc.description: Application routine, not an SDK function. record[0] selects the channel with the same codes as the SDK: 0, 2, 4 or 6 for CH1..CH4, and any other value makes it return without writing. record[1] bit 0 is the polarity CxP and bit 1 the complementary polarity CxCP (CH1 to CH3 only). record[2] bits 1:0 are written to the channel-configure field CxC, and record[3] bits 3:0 to the output control CxOCTRL (3 bits) plus CxOSEN. param_3 bit 0 is CxOIEN (output immediately enable) and bit 1 is CxOBEN (output buffer enable). Finally the main enable CxEN is set in CCTRL, and the complementary enable CxCEN is left unchanged. The CCTRL, CM1/CM2 and CxOIEN/CxOBEN bit positions follow the TMR register data for each channel.

params.name: param_2
params.description: 4-byte channel record: [0] channel code, [1] polarities, [2] CxC, [3] output control and OSEN

params.name: param_3
params.description: bit 0 = output immediately enable (OIEN), bit 1 = output buffer enable (OBEN)

mcu_0160_0800decc.notes: Only caller: mcu_0160_08009800. Differs from the SDK tmr_output_channel_config (mcu_0160_0800e012): it writes CxC from the record instead of clearing it, and it does not set the idle states or CxCEN.

mcu_0160_0800dff8.name: tmr_interrupt_enable
mcu_0160_0800dff8.summary: Set or clear TMR interrupt and DMA enable bits in IDEN
mcu_0160_0800dff8.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_interrupt_enable. With param_3 == 1, param_2 is ORed into the interrupt/DMA enable register IDEN (offset 0x0C); with param_3 == 0 those bits are cleared; any other value leaves IDEN unchanged. The mask uses the TMR_*_INT bits of IDEN, for example bit 0 OVFIEN, bit 1 C1IEN, bit 2 C2IEN and bit 3 C3IEN. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800e012.name: tmr_output_channel_config
mcu_0160_0800e012.summary: Configure a TMR output channel (idle states, output mode, polarity, enables) from a 7-byte record
mcu_0160_0800e012.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_channel_config. param_2 is the channel code 0, 2, 4 or 6 for CH1..CH4, and param_3 points to a 7-byte tmr_output_config_type: [0] oc_mode (3 bits, into CM1 or CM2 at bits 6:4 for CH1/CH3 or 14:12 for CH2/CH4), [1] oc_idle_state (CTRL2 bit 8 + code), [2] occ_idle_state (CTRL2 bit 9 + code), [3] oc_polarity (CCTRL bit 2*code+1), [4] occ_polarity (bit 2*code+3), [5] oc_output_state (CxEN, bit 2*code) and [6] occ_output_state (CxCEN, bit 2*code+2). Each of these fields is written, so the output-enable bits are set or cleared from the record. For CH4 the complementary polarity and enable fields land in reserved CCTRL bits 14 and 15. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_2
params.description: channel code: 0 = CH1, 2 = CH2, 4 = CH3, 6 = CH4

params.name: param_3
params.description: tmr_output_config_type record (7 bytes, layout in description)

mcu_0160_0800e012.notes: The decompile does not clear the CxC channel-configure bits, which the SDK sets to FALSE. Callers: mcu_0160_08003060, mcu_0160_0800a6b8.

mcu_0160_0800e102.name: tmr_output_default_para_init
mcu_0160_0800e102.summary: Zero the seven fields of a tmr_output_config_type (default output channel setup)
mcu_0160_0800e102.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_default_para_init. It clears the 7-byte record at param_1: output mode OFF (0), idle states FALSE, polarities ACTIVE_HIGH (0) and output enables FALSE. The caller fills in the fields it needs and passes the record to tmr_output_channel_config (mcu_0160_0800e012). Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).
mcu_0160_0800e102.notes: Same body as mcu_0160_0800de08 (tmr_brkdt_default_para_init). Callers: mcu_0160_08003060, mcu_0160_0800a6b8.

mcu_0160_0800e114.name: tmr_output_enable
mcu_0160_0800e114.summary: Set or clear the main output enable (BRK.OEN, bit 15) of the TMR
mcu_0160_0800e114.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_output_enable. Read-modify-write of bit 15 (OEN) of the BRK register (offset 0x44) with param_2 & 1. This is the master output switch; it is separate from the per-channel enables in CCTRL. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800e11e.name: tmr_overflow_request_source_set
mcu_0160_0800e11e.summary: Set CTRL1.OVFS (bit 2): overflow event source selection
mcu_0160_0800e11e.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_overflow_request_source_set. Read-modify-write of bit 2 (OVFS) of CTRL1 with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. The register data only names it 'Overflow event source'; the usual meaning is that when it is set, only counter overflow generates the overflow event. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

params.name: param_1
params.description: TMR base pointer (first word is CTRL1)

mcu_0160_0800e128.name: tmr_repetition_counter_set
mcu_0160_0800e128.summary: Write the 8-bit repetition counter value (RPR, offset 0x30)
mcu_0160_0800e128.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_repetition_counter_set. Replaces bits 7:0 of RPR (offset 0x30) with param_2 & 0xFF and keeps the upper bits. RPR sets how many counter periods pass between update events. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800e132.name: tmr_sub_mode_select
mcu_0160_0800e132.summary: Select the slave (subordinate) mode, STCTRL.SMSEL bits 2:0
mcu_0160_0800e132.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_sub_mode_select. Read-modify-write of bits 2:0 (SMSEL) of STCTRL (offset 0x08) with param_2 & 7, which selects the slave-mode behaviour of the timer. The code-to-mode table is not in the repo register data. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800e13c.name: tmr_trigger_input_select
mcu_0160_0800e13c.summary: Select the slave trigger input source, STCTRL.STIS bits 6:4
mcu_0160_0800e13c.description: Matches the Artery SDK tmr_trigger_input_select. Read-modify-write of bits 6:4 (STIS) of STCTRL (offset 0x08) with param_2 & 7. STIS picks which internal trigger input feeds the slave controller; the mapping from code to trigger source is not in the repo register data. Part of the TMR register-helper group in this packet (mcu_0160_0800dd98 to mcu_0160_0800e22e).

mcu_0160_0800e1a2.name: mcu_tmr_swevt_trgswtr_set
mcu_0160_0800e1a2.summary: Set or clear the software trigger event bit SWEVT.TRGSWTR (bit 6)
mcu_0160_0800e1a2.description: Read-modify-write of bit 6 (TRGSWTR) of the software event register SWEVT (offset 0x14) with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. Writing 1 requests a software trigger event, as the register data describes it. Unlike the SDK tmr_event_sw_trigger, which ORs a mask into SWEVT, this writes one bit and so can also write 0. It is one of the setup steps in mcu_0160_0800ac52.

params.name: param_2
params.description: 1 = request software trigger event, 0 = write 0 to the bit

mcu_0160_0800e1ac.name: mcu_tmr_swevt_brkswtr_set
mcu_0160_0800e1ac.summary: Set or clear the software brake event bit SWEVT.BRKSWTR (bit 7)
mcu_0160_0800e1ac.description: Read-modify-write of bit 7 (BRKSWTR) of the software event register SWEVT (offset 0x14) with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. Writing 1 requests a software brake event (register data: 'Brake event triggered by software'), so the brake logic acts as if the brake input had fired. It is one of the setup steps in mcu_0160_0800ac52, which calls it with 1.

params.name: param_2
params.description: 1 = request software brake event, 0 = write 0 to the bit

mcu_0160_0800e1ac.notes: The bit position is certain. How the break logic reacts to it depends on the BRK configuration that is not visible in this packet. Only caller: mcu_0160_0800ac52.

mcu_0160_0800e224.name: mcu_tmr_iden_c2ien_set
mcu_0160_0800e224.summary: Enable or disable the channel 2 compare interrupt (IDEN.C2IEN, bit 2)
mcu_0160_0800e224.description: Read-modify-write of bit 2 (C2IEN) of the interrupt/DMA enable register IDEN (offset 0x0C) with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. It is a single-bit update, not the mask-based SDK tmr_interrupt_enable. It is one of the setup steps in mcu_0160_0800ac52, which calls it with 1.

mcu_0160_0800e22e.name: mcu_tmr_iden_c3ien_set
mcu_0160_0800e22e.summary: Enable or disable the channel 3 compare interrupt (IDEN.C3IEN, bit 3)
mcu_0160_0800e22e.description: Read-modify-write of bit 3 (C3IEN) of the interrupt/DMA enable register IDEN (offset 0x0C) with param_2 & 1, keeping the other bits. Same pattern as mcu_0160_0800e224 for channel 3; it is called from mcu_0160_0800ac52 with 1.

mcu_0160_0800e3dc.name: wdt_divider_set
mcu_0160_0800e3dc.summary: Set the watchdog clock prescaler, WDT.DIV bits 2:0
mcu_0160_0800e3dc.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_divider_set. Read-modify-write of WDT.DIV (0x40003004): bits 2:0 are replaced with param_1 & 7 and the other bits are kept. The register is only writable after the unlock key is written to WDT.CMD (see mcu_0160_0800e3fc). Watchdog setup helper (group of three with wdt_register_write_enable and wdt_reload_value_set, all called from mcu_0160_0800b4e8).
mcu_0160_0800e3dc.notes: The code-to-divide-ratio table is not in the repo register data. Only caller: mcu_0160_0800b4e8, which passes 5.

mcu_0160_0800e3fc.name: wdt_register_write_enable
mcu_0160_0800e3fc.summary: Unlock (0x5555) or lock (0x0000) write access to the WDT DIV and RLD registers
mcu_0160_0800e3fc.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_register_write_enable. A non-zero argument writes the unlock key 0x5555 to WDT.CMD so that DIV and RLD can be modified; a zero argument writes 0x0000 to lock them again. Both are plain stores to CMD. The caller mcu_0160_0800b4e8 uses it around wdt_divider_set and wdt_reload_value_set, then writes 0xCCCC to WDT.CMD to start the watchdog (the SDK wdt_enable). Watchdog setup helper (group of three with wdt_register_write_enable and wdt_reload_value_set, all called from mcu_0160_0800b4e8).

mcu_0160_0800e414.name: wdt_reload_value_set
mcu_0160_0800e414.summary: Write the watchdog reload value to WDT.RLD (offset 0x08)
mcu_0160_0800e414.description: Matches the Artery SDK wdt_reload_value_set. Stores param_1 into WDT.RLD at 0x40003008 with a full 32-bit write; the register data gives RLD as 12 bits, so only the low 12 bits take effect. It must follow wdt_register_write_enable with a non-zero argument or the write is ignored. Watchdog setup helper (group of three with wdt_register_write_enable and wdt_reload_value_set, all called from mcu_0160_0800b4e8).
